summary: SOLAI Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on July 16, 2026 it received a NYSE delisting notice because its average global market capitalization fell below $15 million over 30 consecutive trading days. The NYSE suspended trading in SOLAI's ADSs (each representing 700 Class A ordinary shares) on that date and will apply to the SEC to delist. The company may seek NYSE Board review. The board chairman stated they are evaluating options. ADSs or ordinary shares are expected to move to OTC Markets, likely reducing liquidity, but business operations and SEC reporting obligations remain unchanged. Watch for appeal outcome and liquidity on OTC.
